description:
Stunning Modern Pool Home in Sought-After Tarzana South – Quiet Street, Prime Location

Welcome to this beautifully reimagined, fully remodeled pool home featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, ideally located on a peaceful, tree-lined street south of Ventura Blvd in one of Tarzana’s most desirable neighborhoods.

This move-in ready, turnkey property offers a bright, light-filled open floor plan with an abundance of natural light and sleek modern finishes throughout, creating a clean and elevated living experience. The garage has been converted into a versatile bonus space that can adapt to a variety of lifestyle needs  and is not included in the listed square footage.

The front yard is enhanced by a mature ficus hedge, providing a sense of privacy and greenery that elevates the home’s curb appeal.

Step outside into your own private backyard oasis with a sparkling pool, designed for true indoor-outdoor living and effortless entertaining.

Situated on a generous 5,500 sq ft lot, the property presents a rare opportunity to expand, reimagine, or further enhance, offering exceptional flexibility for a variety of future possibilities.

Conveniently located near Ventura Blvd, local shuls, shopping, dining, and easy freeway access.

A rare opportunity to own a turnkey Tarzana pool home with strong lifestyle appeal and long-term potential.
